name: KTI
recent: KTI Landmark Berhad 近期出现董事及主要股东权益变动，集团董事总经理兼首席执行官 Datuk Loke Theen Fatt 在公开市场多次出售股份。公司最新季度（2026年6月30日止）营收同比增长，但净利同比下滑。
notable: 集团董事总经理兼首席执行官 Datuk Loke Theen Fatt 于2026年10月13日、20日及21日出售公司股份。
公司于2026年8月27日公布截至2026年6月30日止季度的合并业绩。
risks: 集团董事总经理兼首席执行官 Datuk Loke Theen Fatt 在2026年10月多次出售股份。
主要股东 Datin Chin Mee Leen 及 Datuk Loke Theen Fatt 的权益申报出现变动。
earnings: 2026年6月30日止季度营收为 MYR 82.115 million，环比增长1.0%，同比增长47.2%；净利为 MYR 2.165 million，环比下降11.4%，同比下降31.6%；净利率为2.6%，低于上一季度的3.0%。

recent_en: KTI Landmark Berhad has recently seen changes in directors' and substantial shareholders' interests, with Group Managing Director/CEO Datuk Loke Theen Fatt disposing of shares in the open market on several occasions. For the latest quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue grew year-on-year while net profit declined year-on-year.
notable_en: Group Managing Director/CEO Datuk Loke Theen Fatt disposed of company shares on 13, 20 and 21 October 2026.
The company announced its consolidated results for the quarter ended 30 June 2026 on 27 August 2026.
risks_en: Group Managing Director/CEO Datuk Loke Theen Fatt disposed of shares multiple times in October 2026.
There were changes in the interest disclosures of substantial shareholders Datin Chin Mee Leen and Datuk Loke Theen Fatt.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 82.115 million, up 1.0% QoQ and up 47.2% YoY; net income was MYR 2.165 million, down 11.4% QoQ and down 31.6% YoY; net margin was 2.6%, lower than 3.0% in the previous quarter.
